seedData.description: Seed objects for the model-debt-cleanup-schema sweep (fragment 67, ADR-037). Demonstrates every new/retargeted property on a FRESHLY-CREATED object, never a patch to an existing seeded row (OpenRegister seed import is create-only). References resolve by slug against existing decidesk base seed objects. besluit-verordening-parkeren-2026 (decision) carries meeting: raadsvergadering-2025-01-15 and agendaItem: begroting-2026-bespreking (REQ-SDM-022, both existing base seed slugs) so the new join is demonstrable on a fresh install. coi-wethouder-vastgoedbelang (conflict-of-interest) references boardMember as the membership seed m-marie-amsterdam (REQ-SDM-023) rather than a participant slug. machtiging-jansen-alv-2026 (proxy-authorization — note the NEW kebab-case seed-object collection key, since this fragment ships together with the slug rename in 63-member-proxy-authorization.json) is a new sibling to the existing machtiging-vandam-begroting/machtiging-alv-jansen-ongetekend/machtiging-devries-ingetrokken fixtures, using person seed slugs marie-janssen/jan-de-vries for grantor/holder and proxyStatus active (REQ-SDM-024); the pre-existing seed objects in 63-member-proxy-authorization.json keep their historical Participant-shaped grantor/holder values untouched — they are the code chain's migration input, not something this schema-only change rewrites. huishoudelijk-reglement-acme-bv (governing-document) carries currentEffectiveDate 2025-09-01 (REQ-SDM-025) on the existing raad-van-bestuur-acme-bv corporate-domain governance body. No seed object demonstrates Person.nextcloudUserId (Task 1b) — that property is populated by the code chain's Participant-to-Person crosswalk repair step, not a fresh seed row here. NOTE (app-wide limitation, consistent with sibling fragments 45/54/55/60/63): relation refs stored as slugs may not resolve on detail pages until the register import maps them to UUIDs.

decision.title: Verordening parkeren 2026
decision.text: Vaststelling van de verordening parkeren 2026, voortvloeiend uit de bespreking van de kadernota begroting 2026.

conflict-of-interest.description: Lid meldt een financieel belang in een vastgoedontwikkeling die onderwerp is van het agendapunt en onthoudt zich van beraadslaging en stemming.

governing-document.description: Huishoudelijk reglement van de raad van bestuur, aanvullend op de statuten.

Decision.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern, mirroring the fragment-55 citesGoverningDocuments delta): this fragment merges ONLY the optional meeting and agendaItem join properties onto the existing decision schema (REQ-SDM-022). Neither is required and no existing property is modified, so decisions created before this change stay valid. Declares the join that MeetingDecisionsTab.vue and AgendaMotionsTab.vue already write silently today, so OpenRegister validates the write instead of silently accepting an undeclared field.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Optional reference to the Meeting this decision was taken in (REQ-SDM-022). Written by MeetingDecisionsTab.vue when a decision is created from a meeting's decisions tab. Empty for decisions created outside a meeting flow (e.g. a citizen-panel or nomination decision).

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem this decision resolves (REQ-SDM-022). Written by AgendaMotionsTab.vue when a decision (motion) is created from an agenda item's motions tab. Empty for decisions not tied to a specific agenda item.

Person.description: An individual person who participates in governance. Popolo: Person. Identity only — organisational role/relationship lives on Membership (ADR-001 §2). Replaces the flat Participant. Carries an optional nextcloudUserId (judge amendment, 2026-08-19, design.md Data-migration section): the Nextcloud account linkage carried over from the retired Participant shim, so the code chain's Participant-to-Person crosswalk has a strong identity key (match order: nextcloudUserId exact -> email exact -> create new) instead of relying on email heuristics alone.

nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud user
nextcloudUserId.description: Optional Nextcloud user ID (login name / UID) of the Nextcloud user this Person represents. Carried over from Participant.nextcloudUserId by the code chain's crosswalk repair step (model-debt-cleanup-code) so vote-casting, proxy delegation, and vote-link personalisation keep a strong identity key once a Participant is retired in favour of Person + Membership.

ConflictOfInterest.description: A declared or detected conflict-of-interest disclosure per MCCG / governance code. As of this change (REQ-SDM-023), boardMember references Membership, not the deprecated Participant shim: a conflict-of-interest declaration is inherently a statement about a person's role/relationship in a specific governance body, and Membership already carries independenceStatus, the exact MCCG-adjacent field a COI declaration is evaluated against.

boardMember.title: Board member
boardMember.description: UUID of the Membership (the board member's role/relationship in this governance body) declaring the conflict of interest (REQ-SDM-023, was Participant).

Participant.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by Person + Membership (ADR-001 §2). Retained as a narrowed shim for exactly four remaining consumers (REQ-PCR-010): the Meeting quorum aggregation (totalParticipantCount/presentParticipantCount), VotingService::resolveParticipantUuid(), Vote.participant, and EngagementRecord.participant. As of this change, ConflictOfInterest.boardMember and ProxyAuthorization.grantor/holder no longer reference Participant (retargeted to Membership/Person respectively — REQ-SDM-023/024). A member or attendee of a governance body.

BoardProxy.description: RETIRED (REQ-SDM-024): superseded by ProxyAuthorization + its proxyStatus property, which now carries this schema's approval-workflow concept (pending-approval -> active -> suspended/revoked). Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete: false, existing rows), but no new BoardProxy rows should be created — use ProxyAuthorization instead. Historical description: a proxy (volmacht) granted by one board member to another for a single meeting; the row ProxyVoteService wrote through /api/proxies and the row the per-holder proxy cap counted; the signed-document side of a volmacht lives on ProxyAuthorization.
